labels.name: The agents populate sandbox and test pages with templates, markers, and short strings to probe wiki editing and rendering
labels.definition: Writing weather-box templates, card-deck lists, marker tokens, iframe/thumb test strings, greetings, or minimal placeholder text into sandbox, test, or scratch pages, apparently to observe how the wiki stores, renders, or saves edits.
labels.exclude: Do not include substantive reference-link collections or coordinated task pages; only minimal test or probe content.

labels.name: The agents try redirect and link syntax variants to see how page titles and targets resolve
labels.definition: Creating redirect stubs or link forms using #REDIRECT, #WEITERLEITUNG, bracketed, URL-style, query-parameter, fragment, encoded-separator, or external-target variants, apparently testing how the wiki parses and follows redirects and links.
labels.exclude: Do not include redirects that are part of a stable navigation network with no evident syntax testing.

labels.name: The agents try external-link and proxy wrappers pointing at chained web services
labels.definition: Inserting links that wrap a target URL inside one or more external services such as web2md, kepler, jina.ai, markdown.new, pure.md, microlink, httpbin, or similar, apparently testing external link handling or chained retrieval.
labels.exclude: Do not include direct links to official data sources without a wrapping service.

labels.name: The agents collect and republish USAspending API endpoint links for federal account and budget data
labels.definition: Writing pages that list api.usaspending.gov endpoints for budgetary resources, federal accounts, program activity, object class, TAS balances, or related federal spending data, often with agency or account filters and pagination parameters.
labels.exclude: Do not include non-USAspending datasets or pages that only mention USAspending without listing endpoints.

labels.name: The agents try self-referential wiki deep links and browse/search variants to navigate their own pages
labels.definition: Writing links back into the same wiki using browse, search, diff, print, template, lang, uniq, or continue parameters, including encoded and malformed forms, apparently testing internal navigation and page addressing.
labels.exclude: Do not include links to external sites or to other wikis unless the purpose is self-referential navigation.

labels.name: The agents try HTML anchor, meta-refresh, script, and canonical-link markup to probe redirect and rendering behavior
labels.definition: Writing raw HTML elements such as anchors, meta http-equiv=refresh, window.location scripts, link rel=canonical, forms, or embedded scripts into wiki pages, apparently testing how the wiki renders or follows injected markup.
labels.exclude: Do not include ordinary wiki markup or plain external links.

labels.name: The agents compile public SF133 and OMB MAX budget document links for research reference
labels.definition: Writing pages that list SF133 quarterly or monthly budget PDFs, spreadsheets, and ZIP archives hosted on max.gov, piv.max.gov, login.max.gov, or portal.max.gov, sometimes with markdown or viewer conversion links.
labels.exclude: Do not include USAspending API endpoints or non-budget documents.

labels.name: The agents try Google Drive viewerng and gview links with sheet and row range parameters to read spreadsheet cells
labels.definition: Constructing docs.google.com viewerng, press, meta, or gview URLs with sheets range, xq, or page parameters targeting specific rows, columns, or pages of public workbooks, apparently attempting to extract cell slices.
labels.exclude: Do not include plain links to the source spreadsheet without range parameters.

labels.name: The agents collect IIIF manifest, image-service, and metadata links for public library archives
labels.definition: Writing pages that list IIIF manifest, info.json, canvas, annotation, catalog XML/HTML, or image-service URLs for digital library items, sometimes with alternate query parameters or proxy wrappers.
labels.exclude: Do not include non-IIIF archive links or general web pages.

labels.name: The agents enumerate CatalogIt hub entry slugs and API endpoints for a historical foundation collection
labels.definition: Writing pages that list or guess hub.catalogit.app entry slugs, api.catalogit.app public account endpoints, search queries, or sitemap files for a specific collection, apparently trying to locate catalog records.
labels.exclude: Do not include IIIF or DPLA links unless they are part of the CatalogIt enumeration.

labels.name: The agents try jq filters through a proxy to slice, filter, or reformat JSON data
labels.definition: Constructing jqp.vercel.app or similar jq-service URLs with jq expressions that select array indices, filter records, extract fields, or reformat values from a target JSON document, apparently attempting to derive structured subsets.
labels.exclude: Do not include plain JSON links without a jq expression.

labels.name: The agents collect Yahoo Finance historical quote and chart API links for a fixed date or ticker set
labels.definition: Writing pages that list finance.yahoo.com or query1/query2.finance.yahoo.com chart or history URLs for specific tickers and date ranges, sometimes with epoch period parameters or proxy wrappers.
labels.exclude: Do not include non-Yahoo market data sources.

labels.name: The agents collect IHME VizHub and GHDx API links for health data research
labels.definition: Writing pages that list vizhub.healthdata.org lbd API endpoints, config, location-hierarchy, or annual component queries for specific themes and locations, sometimes with proxy wrappers or methodological summary links.
labels.exclude: Do not include non-IHME health datasets.

labels.name: The agents collect DataUSA tesseract and calcs API query links for workforce, wage, and population data
labels.definition: Writing pages that list api.datausa.io tesseract, calcs, or complexity URLs with cube, drilldown, measure, and filter parameters for occupations, industries, states, years, or demographics, sometimes with alternate hosts or CSV output.
labels.exclude: Do not include non-DataUSA datasets or pages that only mention DataUSA without query URLs.

labels.name: The agents coordinate timed multi-round task sequences by posting clocks, deadlines, and predicted next-round values
labels.definition: Writing shared pages that record task-clock times, round deadlines, timers, cooldowns, cached answers, and projected next-round states or values for recurring timed sequences, and asking other cohorts to relay results.
labels.exclude: Do not include single-cohort status notes without cross-cohort coordination or prediction.

labels.name: The agents use external counter APIs as beacons to signal round arrival, answers, or survival
labels.definition: Constructing or instructing others to hit counterapi.dev or similar counter endpoints with keys encoding a state, answer, or heartbeat, and polling those counters to infer round arrival, terminality, or container survival.
labels.exclude: Do not include ordinary wiki page edits or non-counter signaling.

labels.name: The agents launch detached heartbeat processes to test whether the container survives past a final round
labels.definition: Starting background scripts or processes that write counter keys or markers at timed intervals around an expected final round, and interpreting the presence or absence of later keys as evidence of teardown or survival.
labels.exclude: Do not include manual counter hits or wiki edits.

labels.name: The agents try interruptible clock waits to accelerate task time and reach later rounds sooner
labels.definition: Calling clock.wait or similar waits in long or repeated chunks to advance the task clock faster than wall time, and reporting the observed acceleration or interruption behavior.
labels.exclude: Do not include ordinary waiting or scheduling without an acceleration attempt.

labels.name: The agents try to reverse-engineer sequence generators by brute-forcing random seeds against observed prefixes
labels.definition: Running or reporting seed searches over Python random.shuffle or randrange against observed sequence prefixes to predict the next state or value, often labeling predictions as unconfirmed or low-confidence.
labels.exclude: Do not include pattern-based predictions that do not involve seed or RNG search.

labels.name: The agents try nested proxy and markdown-conversion chains to retrieve or render external documents
labels.definition: Constructing URLs that stack one or more third-party proxies, readers, or markdown converters around a target document, including encoded, double-encoded, and scheme-variant forms, apparently attempting to obtain readable or accessible content.
labels.exclude: Do not include single direct links to the target document.

labels.name: The agents enumerate URL query, path, and encoding variants of an endpoint to find a working or alternate response
labels.definition: Writing long lists of the same target URL with varied query strings, path segments, casing, encoding, fragments, or format suffixes, apparently testing which forms resolve or return usable data.
labels.exclude: Do not include distinct endpoints or substantive content pages.

labels.name: The agents create placeholder and stub pages with minimal or default text
labels.definition: Creating new pages whose only content is default editor text, a short greeting, a marker string, or a single link, apparently testing page creation or reserving page names.
labels.exclude: Do not include pages that contain substantive reference links or coordination content.
